message.content: In the conversation, Jareth mentions that he particularly enjoyed a side mission involving helping the widow in the honor system. This side quest allowed Jareth to see Arthur's transformation from a rough outlaw to someone who genuinely cares about his loved ones. Jareth describes how this interaction highlighted Arthur's empathy and showed his growth. This side mission seems to have deeply impacted Jareth, adding to the overall emotional and narrative richness of the game.
